title: SoftWater: Class-Aware Rate Allocation for Softmax Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2608.12026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training quantization pipelines routinely leave the softmax output layer in high precision. Yet in small LLMs with modern vocabularies, the head holds 15--30\% of all parameters, so a nominal ``2-bit'' model with an fp16 head can store several times as many bits per weight. We pose softmax-layer quantization as a rate-distortion problem under the KL divergence between the original and quantized output distributions. A second-order analysis reveals a class-aware geometry: quantization error is weighted jointly by feature covariance and class-specific softmax curvature. A separability approximation replaces the $Kn\times Kn$ Cholesky with one $n\times n$ factorization rescaled per class, making the lattice encodable by successive interference cancellation, with both statistics from a single forward pass. translated_title: SoftWater：面向Softmax量化的类别感知码率分配
translated_abstract: 摘要：后训练量化流程通常会将softmax输出层保持在高精度。然而，在具有现代词表的较小大型语言模型中，输出头占所有参数的15%至30%，因此，一个标称“2比特”的模型若带有fp16输出头，每个权重实际存储的比特数可能高出数倍。我们将softmax层量化问题视为原始输出分布与量化输出分布之间KL散度下的率失真问题。二阶分析揭示了一种类别感知的几何结构：量化误差由特征协方差和类别特定的softmax曲率共同加权。一种可分离性近似将$Kn\times Kn$的Cholesky分解替换为每个类别重新缩放的一次$n\times n$分解，使得格码可通过连续干扰消除进行编码，且两种统计量均来自单次前向传播。由此产生的方法SoftWater，为频繁且低方差的类别提供细粒度格码，而为稀有类别提供粗粒度格码，这造成了显著的差距。
tldr: SoftWater提出了一种基于KL散度率失真分析的类别感知量化方法，通过可分离性近似和连续干扰消除，在保持性能的同时大幅压缩softmax层。
en_tdlr: SoftWater proposes a class-aware quantization method based on KL-divergence rate-distortion analysis, leveraging separability approximation and successive interference cancellation to significantly compress the softmax layer while maintaining performance.
